name: Dragon arrows
description: Higher base ranged strength than rune arrows, with no other special mechanic beyond raw stats — included here mainly because players often assume there's a hidden proc there isn't.

name: Amethyst arrows
description: 5% extra accuracy compared to what raw ranged strength would suggest, making them more accurate than dragon arrows against high-defence targets despite lower max hit.

name: Ruby bolts (e)
description: Chance to deal damage equal to 20% of the target's current HP (10% on players) as a bonus hit, capped at 100 damage.

name: Diamond bolts (e)
description: Chance for a guaranteed critical-style bonus hit dealing extra damage, ignoring some defensive bonuses.

name: Onyx bolts (e)
description: 11% chance in PvM (10% in PvP) to deal 20% extra damage and heal the attacker for 25% of the damage dealt; does not work on undead targets.

name: Opal bolts (e)
description: 5% chance to deal bonus damage equal to visible Ranged level / 10, regardless of whether the attack itself hits.

name: Pearl bolts (e)
description: 6% chance to deal bonus damage equal to 1/20 of Ranged level (1/15 vs. fiery targets), even on a missed attack.

name: Emerald bolts (e)
description: 55% chance on a successful hit to poison for 5 damage, totaling roughly 75 damage over 7.5 minutes; the poison chance is not boosted by a Serpentine helm.

name: Sapphire bolts (e)
description: In PvM, 25% chance to drain 1/10 of the target's Ranged level from its Prayer points and restore 1/8 of that amount to the attacker.

name: Jade bolts (e)
description: 6% chance to knock the target down for 8 ticks, resisted by an Agility roll; fully blocked by Protect from Magic.

name: Dragonstone bolts (e)
description: 6% chance to deal bonus dragonfire damage equal to 20% of visible Ranged level; fully blocked by dragonfire immunity or Protect from Magic.
